scoring_justification: Primary defect numbers and simulation-derived saturation concentrations and leakage currents are compared against the paper's reported values with tolerances; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible without the full cluster dynamics simulation code and hidden reference data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for primary defect counts, saturation concentrations/fluences, and leakage currents from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (Huhtinen column), Section III-C text, Table II
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's reported numbers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published results used as hidden reference for comparison

outputs.description: Primary defect counts per alpha particle using the Huhtinen method.
Saturation fluences and maximum concentrations of VO, V2O, V3O.
Leakage current at three alpha fluences computed from V2O concentration.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are compared to hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances. The primary defect coefficients from Huhtinen (2002) are the same as for 10 MeV protons; SRIM vacancy count is 170 per alpha. The simulation evidence file (concentration_evolution.csv) is not scored but documents that the cluster dynamics step was executed.
